title: Full-Stack Web Development
tagline: Web apps and dashboards built with React, TypeScript and Node.js.
summary: Shahan Ali builds accessible web apps, dashboards and Node.js APIs. From the first screen to the database, he keeps the code clear and easy to maintain.
overview: A useful web app should feel quick and work on every screen. I build interfaces with React and TypeScript. For data and business logic, I use Node.js APIs with MySQL or Firebase when the project needs them.
I also check keyboard access, mobile layouts and page markup. That way, people can use the site and search engines can read its content.
deliverables: Custom React & TypeScript single-page and server-rendered web applications
Admin dashboards, interactive data tables, and client portals
Node.js REST API endpoints, webhook handlers, and database integration (MySQL / Firestore)
Responsive, accessible UI with semantic markup, structured data, and clean deployment configuration
idealFor: Founders, small businesses, and product teams who need a custom web app, internal dashboard, or fast marketing site built with clean, readable code.

title: WhatsApp Bot Development & Automation
tagline: WhatsApp bots for replies, group tools and repeat tasks.
summary: Shahan Ali builds WhatsApp bots with Node.js and Baileys, the library used by ProBoy-MD. Bots can handle replies, group tools and API connections.
overview: ProBoy-MD has 224 command files across nine categories. That work informs how I build other WhatsApp bots: each command has its own job, which makes changes easier to test.
A pairing code connects the bot to WhatsApp. I also add permission checks and guards to stop the same message from being handled twice.
deliverables: Custom Node.js + Baileys multi-device WhatsApp bot architecture
Modular command routing with prefix handling, aliases, and role permissions
Automated inquiry replies, order/status notifications, and webhook triggers
Group moderation rules, media utilities, and cloud hosting setup (Render / VPS)
idealFor: Businesses, online communities, and operators looking to automate repetitive WhatsApp responses, notifications, or group management workflows.

title: Shopify Development
tagline: Shopify themes that make products easy to find and buy.
summary: Shahan Ali customizes Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes with Liquid, Shopify's template language. Work can include product pages, filters, carts and store speed.
overview: A good store should look right and load fast on a phone. I use Liquid, Shopify's template language, to make custom sections, product filters and carts.
I can also connect order or stock updates through webhooks. These are messages Shopify sends when something changes.
deliverables: Custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 sections and Liquid template customization
Mobile-first product pages, variant selectors, and slide-out cart drawers
Collection filtering, search UX improvements, and storefront speed optimization
Order/inventory webhook integrations and custom store utilities
idealFor: D2C brands and e-commerce merchants launching a new Shopify store or upgrading an existing theme for cleaner mobile UX and faster page loads.

title: AI Integrations & Automation
tagline: Gemini-powered tools for websites, chat and routine work.
summary: Shahan Ali adds Google Gemini tools to web apps and bots. He connects prompts and APIs to useful features and handles errors clearly.
overview: AI is useful when it solves a clear problem. For example, Gemini can help a chat bot answer questions or turn a prompt into a structured draft.
I check inputs and handle failed requests so the app explains what happened instead of pretending an answer was sent.
deliverables: Google Gemini API integration for React web apps and Node.js services
AI-powered chat and command helpers inside WhatsApp bots
Structured prompt templates, response formatting, and validation guards
Automated multi-step API workflows connecting forms, chat, and databases
idealFor: Product builders and small teams looking to embed reliable Gemini AI assistants or automated text/data workflows into existing websites or messaging channels.
